QuestionText: The distance covered per unit time is called
Explanation: Speed = Distance / Time. It tells how fast an object moves regardless of direction.

QuestionText: The SI unit of speed is
Explanation: The SI unit of speed is metre per second (m/s).

QuestionText: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. Its speed is
Explanation: Speed = Distance/Time = 120/2 = 60 km/h.

QuestionText: The device used to measure distance travelled by a vehicle is called
Explanation: An odometer (also called trip meter) records the total distance travelled by a vehicle.

QuestionText: The device that measures the speed of a vehicle is called
Explanation: A speedometer indicates the current speed of a vehicle.

QuestionText: The basic unit of time in SI system is
Explanation: The SI unit of time is the second (s).

QuestionText: A body moving in a straight line with uniform speed has
Explanation: Uniform motion: equal distances in equal intervals of time along a straight line.

QuestionText: A body moving with changing speed has
Explanation: Non-uniform motion: unequal distances covered in equal time intervals; speed changes.

QuestionText: The time period of a simple pendulum depends mainly on
Explanation: The time period T = 2π√(L/g) depends on the length L and gravity g, NOT on mass or amplitude (for small swings).

QuestionText: One oscillation of a pendulum is
Explanation: One oscillation = one complete to-and-fro motion (from one side to the other and back).

QuestionText: The time taken for one complete oscillation is called
Explanation: Time period: the time for one complete oscillation of a pendulum.

QuestionText: Convert 72 km/h to m/s
Explanation: To convert km/h to m/s: multiply by 5/18. 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s.

QuestionText: Convert 15 m/s to km/h
Explanation: To convert m/s to km/h: multiply by 18/5. 15 × 18/5 = 54 km/h.

QuestionText: A train travels 450 km in 5 hours. What is its average speed?
Explanation: Average speed = Total distance/Total time = 450/5 = 90 km/h.

QuestionText: A distance-time graph of uniform motion is a
Explanation: Uniform motion produces a straight line (with positive slope) on a distance-time graph.

QuestionText: The slope of a distance-time graph represents
Explanation: Slope = rise/run = distance/time = speed. Steeper slope means greater speed.

QuestionText: A horizontal line on a distance-time graph means the object is
Explanation: A horizontal line means distance is not changing with time: the object is stationary.

QuestionText: A steeper slope on a distance-time graph indicates
Explanation: Steeper slope = greater rise (distance) per unit run (time) = greater speed.

QuestionText: The pendulum of a clock makes 60 oscillations in 30 seconds. Its time period is
Explanation: Time period = Total time / Number of oscillations = 30/60 = 0.5 s.

QuestionText: Sundial is one of the oldest devices to measure ___
Explanation: Sundials use the shadow of a gnomon cast by the sun to indicate the time of day.

QuestionText: A stone is dropped from a cliff. Its speed ___
Explanation: Gravity accelerates the falling stone: its speed increases over time (non-uniform motion).

QuestionText: The distance between two stations is 120 km. A train stops for 0.5 h in between and takes total 2.5 h. Its actual running speed is
Explanation: Running time = 2.5 - 0.5 = 2 h. Speed = 120/2 = 60 km/h.

QuestionText: Two towns A and B are 100 km apart. Car X takes 2 h and Car Y takes 4 h. Ratio of their speeds
Explanation: Speed X = 50 km/h, Speed Y = 25 km/h. Ratio = 50:25 = 2:1.

QuestionText: An athlete runs 400 m in 50 seconds. Speed in m/s
Which motion does a child on a swing undergo?
Explanation: A swing moves back and forth periodically: oscillatory motion.

QuestionText: The motion of Earth around the Sun is
Explanation: Earth's orbit around the Sun repeats in a fixed period (one year): periodic motion.

QuestionText: A second pendulum has a time period of
Explanation: A second pendulum is defined as one with a time period of 2 seconds (1 second each way).

QuestionText: Average speed = ___
Explanation: Average speed = Total distance covered / Total time taken.

QuestionText: If a car travels 60 km in 1 h and 90 km in 2 h total, its average speed is
Explanation: Total distance=150 km. Total time=3 h. Average speed=150/3=50 km/h.

QuestionText: A body covers equal distances in unequal time intervals. Its motion is
Explanation: Uniform motion requires equal distances in equal time intervals. Unequal time for equal distances = non-uniform.

QuestionText: The graph of distance vs time for non-uniform motion is
Explanation: Non-uniform motion produces a curved (not straight) distance-time graph.

QuestionText: A freely falling body starting from rest falls 5 m in the first second and 20 m in the first 2 seconds. This shows
Explanation: Unequal distances (5 m, then 15 m more) in equal time intervals = non-uniform/accelerated motion.

QuestionText: The motion of the hands of a clock is
Explanation: Clock hands move in circles with a fixed period: periodic and circular motion.

QuestionText: A car accelerates from 0 to 60 km/h in 10 seconds. This is an example of
Explanation: Speed is changing (increasing): non-uniform accelerated motion.

QuestionText: Speed of light is approximately
Explanation: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 3 × 10^8 m/s (300,000 km/s).

QuestionText: A cyclist and a pedestrian start at the same time. The cyclist's distance-time line is steeper. Who is faster?
Explanation: Steeper slope on distance-time graph = greater speed. Cyclist is faster.

QuestionText: In a speed-time graph of uniform motion the graph is
Options: B) A line with positive slope
Explanation: Uniform motion = constant speed. Speed vs time graph is a horizontal line.

QuestionText: How long does it take to travel 300 km at 60 km/h?
Explanation: Time = Distance/Speed = 300/60 = 5 hours.

QuestionText: Distance covered in 3 hours at 40 km/h
Explanation: Distance = Speed × Time = 40 × 3 = 120 km.

QuestionText: The bob of a pendulum starts from extreme position. It reaches the other extreme in 0.8 s. What is the time period?
Explanation: From one extreme to the other is half a period. Full period = 2 × 0.8 = 1.6 s.

QuestionText: A pendulum completes 20 oscillations in 40 seconds. Its frequency is
Explanation: Frequency = number of oscillations / time = 20/40 = 0.5 Hz.

QuestionText: Frequency and time period are related as
Explanation: Frequency (f) = 1/Time period (T). They are reciprocals of each other.

QuestionText: A train 200 m long passes a pole in 10 seconds. Speed of train is
Explanation: Speed = distance/time = 200/10 = 20 m/s. The entire train must pass the pole: distance = train length.

QuestionText: Two trains each 100 m long approach each other at 30 m/s and 20 m/s. Time to pass each other completely
Explanation: Combined length = 200 m. Relative speed = 30+20 = 50 m/s. Time = 200/50 = 4 s.

QuestionText: A car travels first half of a journey at 60 km/h and second half at 40 km/h. Average speed for entire journey
A bird flying in a straight path covers 50 m in the first second 50 m in second and third seconds each. Its motion is
Explanation: Equal distances (50 m) in equal time intervals (1 s each): uniform motion.

QuestionText: A boat travels 30 km downstream in 3 h and 30 km upstream in 5 h. Speed of stream is
Explanation: Downstream speed=10 km/h. Upstream=6 km/h. Stream speed=(10-6)/2=2 km/h.

QuestionText: Distance-time graph of two objects A and B: A's line starts at origin with slope 2, B's with slope 4. At what time do they have the same distance from origin?
Options: A) They never have same distance from origin after t=0
Explanation: A: d=2t. B: d=4t. These are never equal for t>0 (both start at origin but diverge). They meet only at t=0.

QuestionText: A cheetah runs 100 m in 4 seconds and a horse runs 200 m in 10 seconds. Which is faster?
Options: A) Cheetah (25 m/s) vs Horse (20 m/s): Cheetah
Explanation: Cheetah: 100/4=25 m/s. Horse: 200/10=20 m/s. Cheetah is faster.

QuestionText: If the length of a pendulum is increased four times its time period becomes
Explanation: T = 2π√(L/g). If L becomes 4L: T_new = 2π√(4L/g) = 2×2π√(L/g) = 2T. Time period doubles.
